data_scope: Complete event graph for frozen backbone; independent E bundle-region and T triplet heads; event-wide assignment.

E.origin: User second sketch: green ordinary edges, yellow shared segments, copied channels and red output paths
E.grouping: CellID families retaining every original HitID
E.labels: Distinct non-noise truth tracks supported by retained underlying candidate hit edges
E.training_sample: At most4096 bundles per event, class stratified
E.loss: Mean cross entropy over endpoint orders, event balanced
E.inference: E class/multiplicity followed by independent expansion and geometric endpoint pairing

T.training_sample: At most8192 triplets per event, balanced positives/hard and random negatives
T.loss: Mean BCEWithLogits over endpoint orders, event balanced

training.extension_condition: Continue only if validation members still improve and fake/clone remain controlled; record LR and continuation.
training.wide_models_condition: Only after evidence of insufficient small-head capacity
training.epoch_definition: All7000 training events visited once; sampled example counts differ by route, report steps and actual time.

runtime.cache: Bounded disk shards with frozen-backbone source/weight/data hashes
runtime.speed_comparison: Same hardware and full pipeline, including I/O and coarse3D

controls: B1 lower edge threshold with old extraction
E0 rule colors with E expansion
T0 rule compatibility with T decoder
gates: No truth-dependent candidate grouping or input features.
Candidate pruning target: at most0.2 percentage-point loss of pure-connectivity upper bound versus unpruned0.4 graph.
Evaluate track efficiency, fake/clone, gained/lost tracks and coarse3D seed quality at matched conditions.
Use paired event-level uncertainty; do not choose size by sampled triplet accuracy alone.
Keep current independent HitID ownership; no synthetic observation duplication.
